description: 2026年5月-6月新增论文补充 - 2026年6月27日搜索更新
search_queries: KV cache compression LLM inference (225 results, 5-6月)
sparse attention LLM quantization pruning (6 results)
key-value cache streaming LLM efficiency (24 results)

papers.name: SubFit
papers.title: From Layers to Submodules: Rethinking Granularity in Replacement-Based LLM Compression
papers.authors: Elia Cunegatti, Marcus Vukojevic, Erik Nielsen, Giovanni Iacca
papers.key_innovation: Submodule-level fitted residual replacement; non-contiguous selection for Attention and FFN; achieves 84.6% downstream accuracy at 25% sparsity

papers.name: Runtime-Certified Quantized Attention
papers.title: Runtime-Certified Bounded-Error Quantized Attention
papers.key_innovation: INT8 keys + INT4 values with FP16 fallback; per-head per-step error bounds; adaptive precision selection with multi-stage fallback ladder
papers.performance: Matches FP16 quality on PG-19, NIAH, RULER up to 128K context

papers.name: GRC
papers.title: GRC: Unifying Reasoning-Driven Generation, Retrieval and Compression
papers.authors: Zhongtao Miao, Qiyu Wu, Yoshimasa Tsuruoka
papers.key_innovation: Unified framework for generation, retrieval, and KV compression in reasoning tasks

papers.name: XFP
papers.title: XFP: Quality-Targeted Adaptive Codebook Quantization with Sparse Outlier Separation for LLM Inference
papers.key_innovation: Dynamic weight quantizer with quality floors; sparse fp16 outlier residual; per-group learned codebook

papers.name: SOL
papers.title: Compute Where it Counts: Self Optimizing Language Models
papers.key_innovation: Dynamic budget allocation per token; joint control of attention sparsity, activation pruning, quantization bit-width

papers.name: VitaLLM
papers.title: VitaLLM: A Versatile and Tiny Accelerator for Mixed-Precision LLM Inference on Edge Devices
papers.key_innovation: Ternary-INT for weights, INT8 for attention; predictive sparse attention with leading-one surrogate

papers.name: LiveStarPro
papers.title: LiveStarPro: Proactive Streaming Video Understanding with Hierarchical Memory for Long-Horizon Streams
papers.authors: Zhenyu Yang, Kairui Zhang, Bing Wang, Shengsheng Qian, Changsheng Xu
papers.key_innovation: Tree-Structured Hierarchical Memory (TSHM) for evicted historical information; Streaming Causal Attention Masks
papers.performance: 28.9% improvement in semantic correctness; 1.58x inference speedup

papers.name: E3RL
papers.title: Shattering the Autoregressive Curse: Dynamic Epistemic Entropy Orchestrated Erasable Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Ziliang Wang, Kang An, Faqiang Qian et al.
papers.key_innovation: Segment-level adaptive dynamic thresholds; reusable KV cache streams; self-healing reasoning capability
papers.performance: 5.349% and 6.514% improvement on AIME for 4B and 8B models

papers.name: DynamicPTQ
papers.title: DynamicPTQ: Mitigating Activation Quantization Collapse via Residual-Stream Dynamics
papers.authors: Zimo Zhao, Maolin Wang, Bowen Yu, Bowen Liu, Xiao Han, Xiangyu Zhao
papers.key_innovation: Phase-aware mixed-precision activation quantization; Jump Ratio and Historical Feature SNR analysis

papers.name: MuKV
papers.title: MuKV: Multi-Grained KV Cache Compression for Long Streaming Video Question-Answering
papers.authors: Junbin Xiao, Jiajun Chen, Tianxiang Sun, Xun Yang, Angela Yao
papers.key_innovation: Patch-, frame-, and segment-level KV extraction; dual signal token compression with self-attention and frequency guidance; semi-hierarchical retrieval
papers.performance: Significant accuracy improvement on long-streaming VideoQA benchmarks

papers.name: SiDP
papers.title: SiDP: Memory-Efficient Data Parallelism for Offline LLM Inference
papers.key_innovation: Weight-as-a-Service and Compute-as-a-Service modes; distributed weight pool across DP group
papers.performance: 1.8x KV capacity increase; 1.5x throughput improvement on Qwen3-32B

Dynamic activation quantization with residual-stream analysis (DynamicPTQ)

Self-healing reasoning with reusable KV cache (E3RL)
